techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/CutClock.tsx:232 Blocks are drawn to scale from clock seconds, picture/voice/music lanes are stable (Cut.tsx:30) and the block moves with the offset via drawnS (Cut.tsx:169). Weakness: no visible legend names the block states.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:102 The bench is right (signed ms, +/-50, snap to mark, stored offset), but derived clips only ever carry ok or missing (lib/cut/deriveTimeline.ts:223,249,280), so a clip nudged +300 ms still shows ok here and the status does not follow the measurement.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Score.tsx:157 CueView has no refused state, so a declined render looks like a cue never rendered. An active take whose bytes are gone still draws ok here, while Voice.tsx checks held and the Cut says take gone. Plates do keep a distinct refused state (Frames.tsx:47).

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Score.tsx:253 The editor draws the derived value and draws no mark when there is no turn; absence is not zero. The two-candidate rule lives upstream of this context.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Motion.tsx:85 A decline is drawn verbatim as a state, and proposals carry provenance (Motion.tsx:99). Judged on decline and provenance only; baked-in audio handling not assessed.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Cut.tsx:114 An edit names an element and a property as a structured op against the record rather than touching pixels; the compile itself is lib/cut/cutDocument.ts, outside this context.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Render.tsx:62 The preview asks for an explicit frame index with a fixed seed; lib/sound/mv/compositor.ts states and implements purity over (seed, frameIndex) with no Date.now or Math.random.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Render.tsx:76 An undecodable still becomes an error naming the input instead of a blank canvas under a preview label. Move one only; no lint pass lives in this context.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/CutFinish.tsx:100 Blocking checks replace the render button, so the priced full render cannot be used to discover a failing check. No contact-sheet rung appears in this surface.

pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:123 The port derives status with a rule that only clears drift, and no derived clip starts as drift, so a clip nudged off its mark reads ok and the finish line's drift row can never fail on a project cut.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:123 lib/cut/offsets.ts only maps drift at zero to ok; deriveTimeline and explainer emit only ok or missing, and isDrifting (finishLine.ts:58) requires status drift. The only drift literal left is the hand-typed TIMELINE row, which this port no longer falls back to.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureScore.ts:65 A second copy of the turn rule beside turnOf (fixtureCut.ts:143), against one derivation for all consumers, and it silently takes the first match where two turn scenes should surface as a material defect.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:121 The drawn position and the offset the bench shows come from one stored value, so the block and the number cannot disagree.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureCut.ts:155 The view carries the digest of the compiled EDL, and an export record keeps the hash it was cut from.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/fixtureMotion.ts:85 The dry direction keeps the decline state with its reason, so a shot with nothing to move stays at rung zero on the fixture side too.

pairs.registryProposal: drift-correction and multitrack-timeline-discipline state the status rule only in one direction (a zeroed clip is shown as placed). Both should also say that a clip moved off its mark becomes drifting, because this code satisfies the literal sentence while a +300 ms clip still reads ok.

pairs.evidence: lib/score/spots.ts:69 A spot's whole address is a list of scene ids, which re-derives on a retime but cannot express a mid-scene entry, exit or authored overhang, so the cue is not free to resolve inside a scene as the technique requires.

techniques.evidence: lib/score/spots.ts:69 Purpose and hard constraints are well carried (takes.ts:83) and silence is not filled, but there is no mark-plus-offset form; the intended tail of a cue survives only as prose at lib/studio/score.ts:167.

lib/score/spots.ts:231 ScoreSpot has no failure or refused field and this projection passes none, so the CueSpot.failure vocabulary reaches only the hand-typed SPOTS fixture; a real refusal cannot be held as a state of the cue. Unplaced movements are honest, with reasons (spots.ts:169).

lib/score/picture.ts:88 The semantic source is a labelled field carrying a note that it is load-bearing, taken from the beat's own kind rather than an index. The position computation lives outside this context.
lib/motion/direction.ts:24 Rung zero is implemented: a plate with no separable element is declined with a reason, and proposed moves are filtered in code against the reading.
lib/studio/score.ts:178 One derivation of the clock from scene holds, with cue spans computed from it; the hand-typed TIMELINE beside it is fixture data.
